identity.note: 隔离实验车道：整仓同步来自上游 WorkLoom-growth，本仓身份/命名在同步时由受控改名器改写；公共根因仍按舰队纪律在基座 workloom-im 修复后再下发。

contract.statement: 同步后本仓与上游的每一处差异必须落在三类之一：①受控改名规则可完全复现；②已登记的差异保留项（declaredDiffs）；③受控只读资产（protectedAssets，必须与上游逐字节一致）。三类之外的差异一律视为未登记漂移，同步操作（--strict）必须失败。
verificationCommands: node scripts/ci/controlled-rename.mjs classify --source <上游仓工作树> --target . --strict
node scripts/ci/controlled-rename.mjs plan --source <上游仓工作树> --target . --json
contract.localReviewedRepairsStatement: Only listed exact local repair bytes are preserved by owner authorization; original frozen upstream refs/digests remain the source of all other protected assets. No distribution or return to base is enabled.
